g.text: The numbers you actually have to hit
Five numbers. You can check any of them in about ten seconds.
Contrast ratio is (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05) with the lighter luminance ontop. It runs from 1:1 to 21:1, and must not be rounded before youcompare it with a threshold.
Large text means at least 18 pt, or atleast 14 pt bold — the spec puts that atroughly 24 px and 18.5 px.
W3C WCAG 2.1 Understanding SC 1.4.3, SC 1.4.6 and SC 1.4.11
